北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴冷，体感 2℃，记得添衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and chilly, feels like 2℃. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光好，体感 9℃，出门享受好天气吧！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny with a pleasant 9℃. Enjoy the lovely weather outdoors!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 10℃，记得关注天气变化。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels like 10℃. Keep an eye on the changing weather.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴暖，体感 15℃。风力 3级，外出注意防风。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm, feels like 15℃. It's breezy, mind the wind!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗暖和，体感 16℃。祝您一天好心情！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and pleasant, feels like 16℃. Have a wonderful day!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感 7℃。风力 4级，外出记得防风。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny but feels like 7℃. It's quite windy, remember your windbreaker!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云，体感 6℃。风力 5级，注意防风保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels like 6℃. With 5-level wind, stay warm and guard against the wind.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴朗，体感 11℃。天气舒适，适合出行。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and comfortable, feels like 11℃. Perfect for going out!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴朗，体感 9℃。风力 4级，别忘了添件外套。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny, but feels like 9℃. With 4-level wind, remember an extra layer.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 11℃。湿度低，记得多补水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and feels like 11℃. Very low humidity, remember to hydrate!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴好，体感 11℃。湿度适中，享受惬意时光。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny and pleasant, feels like 11℃. Enjoy the comfortable weather!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴冷，体感 -20℃！务必做好最强防寒。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and extremely cold, feels like -20℃! Please bundle up warmly.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴冷，体感 -1℃。请注意保暖，小心感冒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and chilly, feels like -1℃. Stay warm and avoid catching a cold.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 10℃。昼夜温差大，早晚添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like 10℃. Mind the temperature difference between day and night.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴好，体感 13℃。风力 3级，祝您愉快！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and feels like 13℃. It's breezy, have a good time!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，体感 -3℃。风力 7级，外出务必防风。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny but feels like -3℃. Extremely windy (level 7), be sure to guard against the wind!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，体感 1℃。风力 4级，小心风寒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, feels like 1℃. With 4-level wind, watch out for the chill.
